rag.text:
Test: TC-1871 — Global - Platform connection warnings - Atlassian Cloud Subsidiary Invalid Connection Reauthorization
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-374 Global - Platform connection warnings
Labels: ppm-e2e-cloud, teamextplatform

Steps:
1. Navigate to configuration -> tasks -> scope definition of  boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1871 Global - Platform connection warnings - Atlassian Cloud Subsidiary Invalid Connection Reauthorization
   Expected: Scope definition tab of program box is opened
2. Click on add new integration button and add JC Subsidiary connection
   Data: [instruction|https://wiki.bigpicture.one/display/DOC/Extplatform+-++QA+Jira+Cloud+Subsidiary+connection+Instruction]
   Expected: JC Subsidiary is added to the box scope and visible
3. Navigate to the page (URL) with API tokens and revoke the token
   Data: URL: https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens
   Expected: Modal window "Revoke API token" is displayed. After Revoking the token it is no longer displayed on the screen
4. After few minutes navigate to primary instance and go to Gantt module of boxName:
   Data: boxName: TC-1871 Global - Platform connection warnings - Atlassian Cloud Subsidiary Invalid Connection Reauthorization
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed.
Warning log appear. The scope is corrupted. Subsidiary Tasks has no access
5. Go to BigPicture Configuration -> Integrations -> Connections
   Expected: JC Subsidiary has status "Not Operational"
6. Navigate to app configuration -> integration click on edit button -> re-autorize
   Expected: Reauthoritize Atlassian Cloud connection window appear
7. Fill in the following fields and click next button
   Data: - Atlassian Cloud Subsidiary instance URL
- E-mail address: email used during the first connection
- Api token: new generated api token
   Expected: After clicking on next button  the window with creating corresponding webhooks  appear
8. Copy Endpoint URL for webhooks -> Open Subsidiary instance -> navigate to Jira settings -> system -> webhooks -> delete existing webhook and
register new using copied endpoint
   Expected: Webhook is registered correctly in Subsidiary instance
9. Go back to BP (primary instance), confirm following steps and click connect button
   Data: folLowing steps:
- I have read the instructions
- I have registered webhooks
   Expected: Connection is active and have status operational
10. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1871 Global - Platform connection warnings - Atlassian Cloud Subsidiary Invalid Connection Reauthorization
   Expected: Gantt module is opened, all tasks from JC Subsidiary are visible in WBS
